summary: Section 3, Leveraging Dynamic Strings: concat(0^{p_j} x_{L_{j-1}}, 0^{u - (d_j + 1)}) (or padding to length u rather than splitting at u, which is invalid since |0^{p_j} x_{L_{j-1}}| = d_j + 1 <= u). Alternatively, split x_{S_{j-1}} into L_{j-1} and pad to length u before or after shifting, instead of attempting to split at u when the length is at most u - 1 if d_j < d_max.
